note: Machine-readable registry of held-out draws that may never again be used for a gate claim. The held-out runner must consult this file and refuse any retired draw id, fixture id or seed.

retired_draws.retired_because: Run before implementation freeze by an unauthorised invocation. run_phase3g.py took a positional cohort argument; the flag form '--cohorts development' matched no known cohort and fell through to a default of {development, heldout}, spending the entire draw. See HELDOUT_DISCLOSURE.md.

rules: A retired draw id may never instantiate a gate run.
A retired fixture id may not appear in a replacement draw, including under a new name. A renamed copy of an exposed structure is still exposed.
A retired seed may not be reused for any held-out cohort.
Development-cohort seeds are not held out and are unaffected.
